title: RB Baseline Index
description: Validation schema for system/baseline_index.json. The canonical contact graph.

id.description: Stable lowercase-hyphenated identifier. Person IDs use firstname-lastname; disambiguate with suffix when needed.

employment_status.description: LinkedIn ended-role cleanup (2026-08-06) — date-aware resolution of whether current_company/current_role is still active. See employment_state.py.

employment_status_source.description: Which adapter last resolved employment_status. Determines outranking: operator_confirmed and any dated source outrank an undated linkedin_connections_export row.

employment_status_observed_at.description: ISO timestamp of the capture that last set employment_status.

employment_end_date.description: Normalized end date of the last dated role, when employment_status is no_stated_current_role and a date was parseable. Day is always 01 (LinkedIn only supplies month/year).

employment_date_confidence.description: Whether employment_status was resolved from an explicit dated range. 'undated' sources (e.g. Connections.csv, which carries no employment dates) must never overwrite a 'dated' or 'operator_confirmed' no_stated_current_role state.

last_known_company.description: Preserved employer when employment_status is no_stated_current_role.

last_known_role.description: Preserved title when employment_status is no_stated_current_role.

last_known_role_dates.description: Raw date-range string of the last known role, e.g. 'Jun 2021 - Mar 2025'.

linkedin_connected_on.description: Raw LinkedIn-export date string, e.g. '29 Apr 2025'.

sources.description: Where this entry came from. Examples: linkedin_export_2026-05-10, google_takeout_2025-12-26, hospitality_table_chat_2026-05-12, salvage_2026-05-08.

company_history.description: RB 9.87 (RB-DEFECT-041 Enhancement #4) — prior current_company values, recorded when linkedin_ingest.py detects a company change. Most recent change last.

title_history.description: RB 9.87 (RB-DEFECT-041 Enhancement #4) — prior current_role values, recorded when linkedin_ingest.py detects a role change. Most recent change last.
